description: This is a Java test class for the ModuleFilterDefinition class within the OpenMRS project. It contains unit tests verifying the functionality of retrieving filter definitions from module configuration XML documents, including scenarios for parsing filters, handling missing configurations, and extracting filter parameters.

classes.name: ModuleFilterDefinitionTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of ModuleFilterDefinition retrieval and parsing.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Static helper method that converts an XML string into a W3C Document object, handling exceptions by returning null.

methods.name: retrieveFilterDefinitions_shouldThrowModuleExceptionIfNoConfig
methods.description: Test that verifies an exception is thrown if the module configuration is null or missing.

methods.name: retrieveFilterDefinitions_shouldReturnEmptyListIfNoFilterNodes
methods.description: Test that verifies an empty list is returned when the XML configuration contains no filter nodes.

methods.name: retrieveFilterDefinitions_shouldReturnListOfSizeOneUsingInitParams
methods.description: Test that verifies a list with one filter definition is returned when the XML contains filter init parameters.

methods.name: retrieveFilterDefinitions_shouldReturnListOfSizeOneUsingFilterNameAndClass
methods.description: Test that verifies a list with one filter definition is returned when the XML contains filter name and class.
